business_scope.primary_industry_name: Non-Vessel Operating Common Carrier (NVOCC) Ocean Box Brokerage

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France–United States Income Tax Convention (1967, as amended by 2006 and 2013 Protocols)
EU–Canada Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA, provisionally applied)
EU–Japan Economic Partnership Agreement (in force February 2019)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code monétaire et financier (CMF), Articles L.561-1 through L.561-60 and R.561-1 et seq., especially L.561-2-2 (beneficial owner definition) and L.561-45-1 (UBO register filing obligation); French Commercial Code (Code de commerce) Article L.123-453 and implementing Decree No. 2018-284 of 18 April 2018; EU Directive (EU) 2015/849 (AML/CFT) as transposed, and the Sapin II Law No. 2016-1691.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of each founder and UBO's passport (identity and signature pages)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport authority of the founder's country of origin; certification by a local notary or a French consular officer
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (if origin state is party to the 1961 Hague Convention) OR Consular Legalization (if not party to the Apostille)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address of each UBO (utility bill or bank statement issued within the last 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or licensed financial institution in the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized translation into French followed by Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization as applicable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing or official company extract for all corporate shareholders holding 25% or more
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Official company registry or competent governmental body of the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization, with French translation if required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and capital deposit attestation (Attestation de dépôt des fonds)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: French credit institution or Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations where the initial capital is blocked
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Original bank signatory letter; no apostille required, consular legalization only if requested by foreign counterparties

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All UBOs, directors, and shareholders with 25% or greater ownership must be screened against the French Financial Intelligence Unit (TRACFIN) guidance, EU Consolidated Sanctions List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, and the French national asset freeze lists. Mandatory PEP screening extends to family members and close associates of politically exposed persons. Enhanced due diligence requires independent verification of the source of funds for PEPs, written risk assessment, senior management approval, and ongoing adverse-media screening. Negative news alerts trigger a mandatory review of the UBO structure and source of wealth.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Infogreffe (www.infogreffe.fr) – central electronic portal of the French Commerce and Companies Registry (Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés, RCS), with formalities submitted via Guichet des Formalités des Entreprises (forma.entreprise.gouv.tr.jp). However the official filing portal is formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr (Guichet Unique)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be in Latin script and must comply with French linguistic rules for mandatory corporate documents. If the chosen name includes non-French characters, a French transliteration must be provided and filed. The name must be distinguishable from existing RCS registrations, must not be misleading, and must not infringe trademarks protected in France. All statutory documentation submitted for incorporation must be in French language.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: In France, there is no formal name reservation; a non-conflicting RCS search certificate is used. If the Guichet Unique or Greffier rejects the proposed name, the applicant may first request a written reconsideration from the Greffier within 8 days of notification, supplying a revised name or evidence of non-confusion. If the refusal is maintained, an appeal may be lodged with the President of the Commercial Court (Juge commis à la surveillance du registre du commerce et des sociétés) within 15 days of receipt of the refusal. The appeal petition must set out the legal grounds, propose an alternative name if appropriate, and attach the rejection notice, the search certificate, and any trademark coexistence agreements. If the rejection is due to an intellectual property conflict, the applicant may simultaneously file a trademark cancellation action or obtain a written non-opposition agreement from the prior right holder.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual registered office is permissible only when provided by a licensed domiciliation company (société de domiciliation) operating under French law and declared to the relevant Prefecture. For an NVOCC ocean freight forwarding SARL, a pure virtual office without any operational physical presence is insufficient: the French transport licensing authority (DREAL / Ministry of Ecological Transition and Territorial Cohesion) requires an actual place of business where statutory records, shipping documents, and customs files are kept, and where personnel can be reached for inspection. Industry tolerance for this regulated activity is low; fiscal and customs authorities expect commercial substance such as invoices, bill-of-lading files, and staff presence at the registered office.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High. Estimated 65% likelihood of an on-site inspection within the first 12 months of licensing, and up to 20% probability of an unannounced visit after initial authorization, due to maritime fraud prevention, customs surveillance, and NVOCC financial solvency controls. The initial inspection is usually announced, but post-license inspections may be unannounced.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Capital deposit attestation (Attestation de dépôt de fonds) at a French bank
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French credit institution or Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of French Articles of Association (Statuts) and governance resolutions for SARL
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for standard SARL incorporation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO registry declaration preparation and AML/KYC screening package (PEP, OFAC, UN, EU, TRACFIN)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark by UBO count and risk profile

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of legal notice in Journal d'Annonces Légales (JAL)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Official legal gazette publisher (JAL) approved by the regional Prefecture
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff per number of lines and department

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Guichet Unique and RCS incorporation filing fee (Form M0, UBO declaration, KBIS issuance)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Guichet des Formalités des Entreprises and Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory governmental tax plus registry tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff for license and capacity assessment

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Code de commerce (French Commercial Code) – Book II: Articles L.210-1 to L.210-10 (general provisions), L.223-1 to L.223-43 (Société à Responsabilité Limitée – SARL), R.123-1 et seq. (Register of Commerce and Companies – RCS); Décret n°84-406 of 30 April 1984 (RCS filing rules); Code des transports – L.1412-2 for auxiliary freight-forwarding registration. The SARL is validly formed even with a nominal stated capital because French law sets no mandatory minimum share capital.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de commerce (Commercial Court Registry) of the registered-office department, operating the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS); all filings are transmitted electronically through the Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprises operated by INPI (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Déclaration de constitution d'une société à responsabilité limitée (formulaire M0) filed via the INPI Guichet unique, accompanied by the signed Statuts (Articles of Association), a certificate of publication of the 'Avis de constitution' in an authorized Journal d'Annonces Légales (JAL), a capital-deposit attestation, and the Declaration of Beneficial Owner (DBE).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital under French law; the capital is freely set in the Statuts. If cash capital is stated, at least 20% of cash contributions must be paid up at formation and the balance within 5 years (Art. L.223-7). The paid-up funds are blocked in escrow at a credit institution or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations (CDC) and are released to the gérant only upon presentation of the RCS Kbis extract.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) the shareholders approve the draft statuts for adoption of [SARL Name] as a Société à Responsabilité Limitée governed by Book II of the French Code de commerce; (2) the share capital of EUR [X], divided into [N] shares, is fully subscribed, and the paid-up portion is deposited in escrow with the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations; (3) the registered office at [address] is adopted; (4) [Name] is appointed gérant for an indefinite term with full powers to bind the company; (5) the gérant is authorized to publish the legal notice, file the formation dossier through the Guichet unique (INPI), and procure the RCS Kbis extract.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft, sign, and date the Statuts (Articles of Association) and verify corporate name availability
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founding shareholders with optional participation of a French notaire; name-availability check through INPI's public data before execution.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Statuts in French setting out the corporate name, registered-office address, share capital, contributions, share-transfer restrictions, gérant powers, duration (max 99 years), accounting year, and dissolution provisions. If a contribution in kind consists of real property, the Statuts must take the form of a notarial deed (acte notarié). Each shareholder signs every page or grants an authenticated power of attorney (procuration). Collect the identity documents and preliminary beneficial-owner information required for the DBE form.
required_dossiers: Draft Statuts (sous seing privé or acte notarié)
Certified copies of identity documents of all shareholders
Power of attorney (procuration) for any remote signatory
Draft Declaration of Beneficial Owner (formulaire DBE)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the corporate name is challenged or reserved, amend the name clause in the Statuts, re-sign the amended pages, and re-verify INPI data; no registry penalty applies at this pre-filing stage.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open a temporary blocked capital account and deposit the paid-up share capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Any licensed French credit institution or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations (CDC).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a dedicated 'compte bloqué' in the name of the company in formation and transfer the paid-up portion of the cash contributions. The bank or CDC issues the 'attestation de dépôt de fonds' certifying the blocked balance, the name of the company, and the condition that funds are released only on production of the Kbis extract. This attestation is mandatory for the RCS filing, save where the Statuts provide a nil stated capital in accordance with the provisions of Book II Code de commerce.
required_dossiers: Draft Statuts
Identity document of the gérant and shareholders
Bank KYC pack (address, source of funds, corporate names)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the credit institution delays or refuses, open the blocked account with a second bank or directly with the CDC's deposit service; the deposit attestation must be re-issued in the exact corporate name to avoid a registry query.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publish the formation announcement (Avis de constitution) in a legal gazette (JAL)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A journal d'annonces légales (JAL) expressly authorized to publish formation notices in the department where the registered office is located.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit to the JAL the mandatory announcement containing the company's legal form (SARL), corporate name, authorized capital amount, registered-office address, the gérant's full identity, and the number of shares. Retain the quote reference and obtain the 'attestation de parution' (certificate of publication), which is usually issued within 1-3 working days from publication. This certificate is annexed to the RCS filing.
required_dossiers: Text of the Avis de constitution signed by the gérant
Invoice/quotation reference from the chosen JAL in the correct department
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the JAL errs or publication is delayed, request a corrective publication at no extra cost, or select an alternative registered JAL; the certificate must exactly match the Statuts and the registry office to avoid rejection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submit the complete digital formation dossier on the Guichet unique operated by INPI
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI – Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr), transmitting automatically to the Greffe du Tribunal de commerce.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the single electronic declaration 'Déclaration de constitution' (M0) in French, uploading the signed Statuts, capital deposit attestation, JAL publication certificate, proof of registered office occupation, declaration of non-disqualification of the gérant, the DBE form, and the prescribed registry fees. The Guichet unique issues an immediate acknowledgment of receipt; the Greffe then has a statutory examination window of 5 business days to register or to issue a request for complementary documents.
required_dossiers: Signed Statuts
Capital deposit attestation (attestation de dépôt de fonds)
JAL publication certificate (attestation de parution)
Proof of registered-office address (title of lease, electricity bill, or occupancy agreement)
Declaration of non-condamnation/policy on manager eligibility
Declaration of Beneficial Owners (DBE)
Electronic M0 declaration form
Power of attorney if filed by a third-party service provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Greffe sends a 'demande de pièces complémentaires', the applicant has 15 calendar days to supply the missing items online and the clock restarts. If registration is refused, the same dossier may be corrected and re-submitted once without additional fee; a further refusal may be appealed to the President of the Tribunal judiciaire (or Tribunal de commerce) within 15 days of notification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain the RCS Kbis extract and activate tax numbers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de commerce of the registered-office department.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Once the Greffe validates the file, the company is inscribed at the RCS and the 'extrait d'immatriculation' (Kbis) is issued electronically, bearing the SIREN/SIRET numbers, APE code 5229B, VAT intra-community number, and the date of legal existence. The gérant presents the Kbis to the bank or CDC to release the blocked capital. The tax authorities then recognize the entity automatically for French corporate income tax (IS) purposes via the DGFiP link through the Guichet unique.
required_dossiers: Formation-file reference number (N° de dossier Guichet unique)
Nothing further; Kbis is issued ex officio by the Greffe
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Kbis is not issued within 10 business days of the complete file, lodge a formal reclamation with the Greffe, then with the President of the Tribunal judiciaire; any undue block due to missing documents is cured by immediate electronic resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-formation governance: employer registration and mandatory declaration for the NVOCC/freight-forwarding activity
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: URSSAF via the Guichet unique; Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (DREAL) / Direction Générale des Infrastructures, des Transports et des Mobilités (DGITM).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Immediately after registration, the gérant concludes the statutory governance documentation (share register, articles of association certified copy), registers the company as an employer with URSSAF, and files the application for inscription in the 'Registre des commissionnaires et courtiers de transport' under Article L.1412-2 of the Code des transports before commencing NVOCC operations. The company must also bind civil liability insurance for freight forwarders and evidence the professional capacity requirement (professional qualification certificate or equivalent).
required_dossiers: Kbis extract and SIRET numbers
Certificate of professional capacity in transport auxiliary (freight forwarding)
Professional civil-liability insurance certificate
Certificate of financial standing/financial guarantee where the company handles client funds
Completed DREAL inscription form (Registre des commissionnaires de transport)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DREAL/DGITM returns the freight-forwarding registration as incomplete, rectify the file within the specified deadline; a refusal or silence of two months may be challenged by a hierarchical appeal to the Préfet de région and subsequently before the administrative tribunal. The NVOCC activity must not begin before the transport-auxiliary registration is effective.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministère de la Transition écologique – Direction Générale des Infrastructures, des Transports et des Mobilités (DGITM); regional enforcement through DREAL; registry maintained as the electronic registre des commissionnaires et courtiers de transport.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Inscription au Registre des commissionnaires et courtiers de transport (transport auxiliaire) under Article L.1412-2 of the Code des transports – mandatory operating authorization for NVOCC ocean freight logistics; complementary maritime registration with customs authorities where the company acts as a customs declarant.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministère de la Transition écologique – Direction Générale de la Prévention des Risques (DGPR); territorial application through DREAL.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category: Exempt (non soumis à évaluation environnementale) for an office-only NVOCC and freight-forwarding company under Article L.122-1 of the Code de l'environnement. If the company later operates a warehouse, container freight station, or cross-dock, a screening (examen au cas par cas) is required, with potential classification under ICPE thresholds (rubriques 1510, 1511, 1530 or 2661 on volumes and stored substances).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Office-only operations: wastewater discharged to the public sewer under the municipal sanitary ordinance and Articles L.1331-10 and R.1331-1 Code de la santé publique; no significant VOC or dust emissions; maintenance activities, if any, must comply with low-VOC solvent thresholds of the French regulation governing volatile organic compound emissions (arrêté du 2 mai 2002). Waste streams (paper, IT equipment, used batteries) are governed by the réglementation relative aux déchets d'activités économiques, with tracking through bordereau de suivi de déchets when hazardous waste is produced. Any incidental cooling or emergency generator must meet local air-emission and ICPE registration conditions.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety: for tertiary (office) premises, initial and annual fire-safety verification by a qualified body (APAVE, SOCOTEC, Bureau Veritas) under the Règlement de sécurité and Code du travail R.4222-1 et seq.; maintain consignes incendie, emergency exits, fire extinguishers, and registre de sécurité. If any reception area is open to the public, the premises become an ERP and require a collective fire-safety commission visit. Electrical installation inspection and verification per Code du travail R.4226-1 series. Workplace clearance: structural-load inspection is not required for normal office use, but the employer must maintain a liaison register and conduct an annual air-quality and ventilation check. Warehouse operations, if added, will trigger the ERP chapter for the specific category, structural load certificates for racking, and compliance with civil-defense requirements in the local fire prevention plan.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction générale des Finances publiques (DGFiP), through the professional tax account on impots.gouv.fr. Business formation and registration formalities are submitted through the Guichet unique operated by INPI; the resulting SIREN and SIRET identifiers are allocated through the national business-register and INSEE processes. VAT administration is handled by the competent Service des impôts des entreprises (SIE), including the Service des impôts des entreprises étrangères for qualifying non-established businesses.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A French SARL is registered through the Guichet unique and receives a SIREN and establishment-level SIRET; its French VAT number is generally assigned by the DGFiP after the business and VAT position are recorded. A foreign entity making taxable supplies in France must register with the competent French tax office before or when its French VAT obligations arise. A business established in another EU Member State generally has no French fiscal-representative appointment requirement. A business established outside the EU must ordinarily appoint an accredited French fiscal representative, unless an applicable mutual-assistance arrangement or legal exception removes that requirement. Applications commonly require formation and registry documents, proof of business activity, identity and authority documents, and evidence of the French taxable activity. Registration obligations may arise without a turnover threshold where the non-established supplier is liable for French VAT; reverse-charge treatment can alter who accounts for VAT on particular transactions.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: A SARL is generally subject to French corporate income tax (impôt sur les sociétés, IS). A qualifying SARL may elect the temporary partnership-style income-tax regime (impôt sur le revenu, IR), generally for up to five financial years, subject to statutory ownership, activity, age, size, and consent conditions. A qualifying family-owned SARL conducting an eligible activity may elect IR treatment without that five-year limit while the conditions remain satisfied. A single-member SARL owned by an individual may, subject to conditions and election, be taxed under IR rules. France does not provide a US-style check-the-box election for ordinary French entities; classification and cross-border hybrid treatment are governed by French law, EU rules, and applicable tax treaties.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT; taxe sur la valeur ajoutée, TVA), with customs duties and excise taxes applying where relevant.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: For an ordinarily established French business eligible for the domestic VAT exemption regime (franchise en base), the general thresholds are EUR 85,000 for sales of goods and specified transactions and EUR 37,500 for services, subject to statutory tolerance thresholds and special rules. These domestic exemption thresholds do not generally protect a non-established supplier that is liable to account for French VAT. Cross-border EU distance sales and services are subject to separate rules, including the EUR 10,000 EU-wide threshold for specified intra-EU distance sales and telecommunications, broadcasting, and electronic services, and the Union/non-Union OSS regimes. A SARL carrying on freight-forwarding activities should determine VAT treatment by supply, customer status, route, and place-of-supply rules rather than relying on a single turnover threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: France is implementing domestic B2B electronic invoicing and transaction/payment-data reporting in phases. From 1 September 2026, businesses within scope must be able to receive electronic invoices; issuance obligations apply from that date to large and intermediate-sized enterprises and generally from 1 September 2027 to small and medium-sized enterprises and micro-enterprises. In-scope invoices are transmitted through a government-approved platform (plateforme de dématérialisation partenaire, PDP), with required data reported to the DGFiP. France's model is not a universal real-time tax-clearance or digital-stamping system. E-reporting applies to specified transactions outside domestic e-invoicing, including relevant cross-border and consumer transactions, subject to the statutory scope and timetable.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods from France to destinations outside the EU may be exempt from French VAT with deduction rights where the statutory export conditions are met and the supplier can prove that the goods left the EU customs territory. Intra-Community supplies may qualify for exemption with deduction rights where the customer has a valid VAT number in another Member State, the goods are dispatched there, and reporting and documentary conditions are met. Services are not automatically zero-rated because the customer or payment is offshore: place of supply, customer status, and applicable exemptions determine treatment. International freight and transport-related services may benefit from specific exemptions or related treatment only where the statutory conditions and documentary evidence are satisfied. Freight forwarders acting as disclosed agents and those acting as principals may have different VAT outcomes; the contractual and invoicing capacity must be established.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs export declaration and export MRN with electronic confirmation of exit from the EU customs territory
Commercial invoice, sales or freight-forwarding contract, and records identifying the supplier, customer, goods, and destination
Bill of lading, sea waybill, or other transport document evidencing carriage and delivery outside the EU
Proof of dispatch, delivery, and export, including carrier or customs-system evidence appropriate to the transaction
For intra-Community supplies: customer VAT-number validation, transport evidence, invoice, and required recapitulative statement reporting
Payment and accounting records supporting the transaction; an inward-remittance certificate is not a general French VAT export requirement
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: France imposes no general 180-day foreign-exchange repatriation deadline for export proceeds. Export exemption claims require contemporaneous evidence of export or other applicable qualifying conditions; inadequate evidence can result in assessment of output VAT, interest, and applicable tax penalties. Deliberate or fraudulent conduct may attract increased penalties and, where the statutory elements are met, criminal sanctions. Input VAT deductions or refunds may be denied or recovered where the underlying transactions are fictitious, mischaracterized, or unsupported. The applicable assessment period and penalties depend on the facts, the type of breach, and whether bad faith or fraud is established.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France) jointly with the French Treasury (Direction Générale du Trésor) under the European Central Bank's monetary policy framework; foreign exchange control powers are primarily exercised by Banque de France in accordance with the Code Monétaire et Financier (Articles R. 916-1 et seq.)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France is in the Eurozone and has fully liberalized both current and capital account transactions. No exchange control approval is needed for trade-related payments, profit remittance, or capital injections. Profit repatriation via dividends or shareholder loans is unlimited and unrestricted, subject only to mandatory tax withholding and anti-money laundering (AML) checks. Reporting duties apply for statistical/balance-of-payments purposes, not authorisation.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No surrender requirement exists in French law. Export proceeds and freight earnings in foreign currency may be held freely in local or offshore bank accounts. The only statutory obligation is a Banque de France balance-of-payments declaration for cross-border transfers exceeding €25,000, which is filed by the instructing bank on behalf of the company. No conversion ratio or mandatory timeline applies.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account and, where required, Capital Escrow Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank (CACIB)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account for large-volume freight settlements, plus ancillary Trade Finance lines
Operational Account with multi-currency USD/EUR capabilities

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium – French-licensed Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs) (e.g., Qonto, N26, Revolut Business, or Eversend) are authorised under PSD2 by the ACPR and offer payment accounts, FX, and cross-border SWIFT-like transfers. They are operationally viable for daily payroll, supplier disbursements, and VAT clearances. However, they are generally unsuitable for a capital escrow account or for high ticket NVOCC transactions because of lower transaction caps, plus enhanced due diligence for the freight forwarding industry, and some EMIs explicitly exclude NVOCC brokers as high-risk. Legal constraints: EMIs cannot provide credit or guarantees, and must comply with the French and European AML/CTF rules on non-resident UBOs.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Not absolutely mandated by French law, but most tier-1 commercial banks require at least one physical/video interview with the legal representative or founder. For non-resident directors (outside the EU/EEA), banks commonly request a physical meeting at the branch or a video-authenticated notarised signature. A 'Kbis' registration extract, original passport copies, apostilled resolutions, and proof of the registered office are typically required. In practice, a French-resident manager or the use of an authorised banking agent facilitates the process.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade activities involving ports or counterparties under international sanctions (e.g., certain Russia/Iran/Cuba-related routes) or shipping lines with recent OFAC/UN enforcement events
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Export sanctions compliance manual, real-time denied-party screening logs, cargo manifests with 6-digit HS codes, shipping line certificates (OFAC/UN attestations), port/berth documentation, and a written compliance opinion from a French law firm.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Monthly freight transaction volume disproportionate to the registered capital, tax filings, or the SARL's declared turnover in the audited financial statements
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: 3 years of audited financials, latest tax filings (liasse fiscale), proforma invoices, original bills of lading (OBL) or sea waybills, arrival/notice of delivery, bank statements from the instructing bank, and signed freight forwarding contracts with shippers and consignees (including client KYC).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Transactions routed through opaque offshore intermediaries or flag-of-convenience shell companies (e.g., in DIFC, BVI, or Hong Kong) without transparent commercial rationale
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full UBO register extract (RNE/LeGuin), corporate registry Kbis extract for the French SARL, the administrative formalities for foreign shareholders, intermediation agreements with commercial substance, a board-approved purpose memorandum, and any FMC/FIATA or transport operator licence evidencing the underlying business.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cash-like disbursements or advance payments to NVOCC wholesalers or 'silent freight owners' who are not the actual shipowners
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Supplier onboarding KYC documentation, trade reference letters, chamber-of-commerce certificates of the supplier, corporate registration for the vessel operator, proof of registered business licence (e.g., FMC OTI or French ARF), customs entry/ISPS-coded shipment records, and the underlying booking confirmation chain.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections into the French SARL must be routed through a fully regulated bank (tier-1) using SWIFT MT103/MT202. Purpose codes must align with the Banque de France's nomenclature: for an equity injection use 'Capital contribution / equity' (Nomenclature code 4000 – Investment), and for a shareholder loan use 'Loan including lease-in' (code 4020 or 4030 depending on maturity). The bank automatically files the balance-of-payments declaration for transfers above €25,000. Supporting documents must include a board resolution from the shareholder, the French SARL's share subscription or loan agreement, the notarial deed (if capital increase), and the Kbis. Verification is also required against the SARL's UBO register and any prior declaration of non-resident shareholding.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails for outbound trade settlements are primarily via SWIFT MT103 for third-country suppliers (especially in USD, CNY, and JPY). Within the SEPA zone, a SEPA payment (E-Mandat) is used for EUR settlements with EU harbours, terminals, and logistics partners. For large charter payments or advance freight discounts requiring documentary protection, a commercial letter of credit (MT700/707) may be used, or a standby L/C as a guarantee for port fees. USD disbursements are typically cleared via Fedwire or CHIPS through the correspondent bank using the SWIFT MT103 network, with the bank's cost-and-benefit analysis supported by a daily FX conversion into the final payment currency.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX Outright Forwards (EUR/USD, EUR/CNY, EUR/GBP) – available under grouping/settlement netting agreements with licensed French credit institutions.
FX Swaps (short-dated EUR/USD or EUR/CNY) – commonly used for managing intra-quarter working capital gaps.
Cross-Currency Interest Rate Swaps (CCIRS) – permissible for converting Euro floating-rate loans into USD fixed-rate obligations if the SARL holds a long-term unhedged USD asset.

Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) – permitted for over-the-counter transactions on restricted/inconvertible currency pairs (e.g., onshore CNY/offshore CNH, INR) only when executed by a French-licensed credit institution with dedicated balance-of-payments reporting and SBRC (Conformité aux réglementations).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Deposit of annual financial statements (balance sheet, profit-and-loss statement, notes) approved by the SARL shareholders' meeting, together with the statutory management report and the register-of-pledges declaration (form 85-4) where applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (commercial registry database consolidated in the Registre National des Entreprises operated by INPI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Ordinary shareholders' meeting must approve the annual accounts within 6 months of fiscal year-end; the approved accounts are deposited within 1 month of approval, giving a maximum 7-month window from year-end (calendar-year SARL: by 31 July of the following year)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Formal notice by the registry clerk, coercive court order with daily compulsory fine (astreinte), loss of the 'a jour' Kbis status, inability to obtain a valid corporate extract for banking and procurement transactions, criminal fine for the SARL manager of up to EUR 15,000, and ultimately administrative strike-off for persistent default

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (form 2065-SD 'Resultats' with the 2031/2050-series BIC schedules and accompanying forms 2069-A, 2069-C and 2571)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Service des Impots sur les Entreprises (SIE) of the Direction Generale des Finances Publiques
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 3 May of the following calendar year for a company closing its accounts on 31 December; companies with a non-calendar fiscal year file within 3 months of the fiscal year-end (electronic filing mandatory)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of 5% of the assessed tax (10% where the default has been formally notified), late-payment interest of 0.20% per month, increase to 40% for bad-faith understatement, and automatic loss of certain tax deduction rights

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of registered company data and beneficial-owner declaration (beneficiaires effectifs) kept at the commercial registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce and INPI (Registre National des Entreprises) through the electronic corporate formalities portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within 2 months following the ordinary shareholders' meeting that approves the annual accounts (meeting due within 6 months of fiscal year-end), i.e., maximum 8 months from fiscal year-end for calendar-year filers; any change in control or ownership must additionally be updated within 30 days of the transaction
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Registry sends a confirmation reminder and marks the file as obsolete; persistent non-confirmation may lead to administrative radiation; knowingly incomplete or false beneficial-owner declarations expose the entity to a fine of up to EUR 15,000 and criminal sanctions for the manager, and the company is precluded from obtaining a valid Kbis extract

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual declaration of business premises (form 1327-COD) and payment of the local business property tax (Cotisation Fonciere des Entreprises)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Service des Impots sur les Entreprises (DGFiP) with assessment collected by the local tax authorities
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Declaration filed at the same due date as the income tax return (by 2 May for a calendar-year company); the assessed tax is paid between 1 November and 15 December of the assessment year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment interest of 0.20% per month on the unpaid CFE, a 10% statutory surcharge after formal notice, enforced recovery by the public treasury, and loss of the right to reduce the assessed value on subsequent declarations

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renewal of the financial-capacity attestation (garantie financiere) covering liabilities of the NVOCC ocean freight forwarder under the French transport and forwarding registration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Regional transport registration authority (Registre des commissionnaires de transport) of the Ministry of Ecological Transition and Territorial Cohesion
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Continuous licensing condition: the renewal certificate must be delivered by the bank or insurer and filed before expiry of the current guarantee, and coverage must be recalculated when annual turnover or the authorized liability cap increases; no fixed calendar date, monitored with the annual license review
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Operation without a valid financial guarantee constitutes a criminal offense under the transport code, triggers immediate suspension or withdrawal of the freight-forwarding registration, leaves unsecured liabilities to be borne personally by the manager, and may be reported by the greffe or the transport authority to the competent prosecutor

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Appointment of a statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) is mandatory where at least two of the following three thresholds are exceeded on the fiscal year-end: total balance sheet above EUR 4,000,000, net VAT-exclusive turnover above EUR 8,000,000, or average workforce above 50 employees; an audit is also compulsory when the SARL controls or is controlled by another undertaking, and may be ordered by the court for the freight-forwarding license at the request of the transport authorities.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable General per ANC Regulation No. 2014-03) for the individual statutory annual accounts; IFRS as endorsed by the European Union is applicable only for consolidated accounts of listed parent groups; the tax return must be reconciled to the French GAAP statutory accounts.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: France applies a register-based system: the beneficial-owner statement is filed with the RCS at incorporation and must be updated within 30 days of any share transfer or change in control; the annual RCS confirmation, due within 2 months after the shareholders' meeting approving the accounts, is the statutory annual attestation of the continued accuracy of the UBO data, and the register of associates must be reconciled before each ordinary annual meeting so that all transfers are recorded in the internal share-transfer register.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of shareholders' decisions and ordinary annual general-meeting records (registre des decisions des associes)
Register of share transfers and capital movements (registre des mouvements de parts sociales)
Minutes book and manager's deliberations register (registre des proces-verbaux du gerant)
Copy of the beneficial-owner declaration as filed at the commercial registry (registre des beneficiaires effectifs)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 320 - 950 per year (approx. EUR 300 - 900) for a commercial domiciliation service in a major French business city; average annual agent contract approximately USD 550
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 6,000 - 22,000 (approx. EUR 5,500 - 20,000) for a stand-alone statutory audit of an SME SARL, depending on headcount, turnover, asset complexity, and the territorial coverage of the forwarding activity

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% standard corporate income tax (IS) rate; SME reduced rate of 15% on the first EUR 38,120 of annual taxable profit for entities with turnover below EUR 10,000,000; a 3.3% social surcharge on the IS liability applies above EUR 763,000 of tax, creating an effective top rate of 25.825%.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced 15% bracket for eligible small businesses; research tax credit (CIR) and innovation tax credit (CII); foreign tax credit relief under applicable tax treaties; no NVOCC-specific sectoral tax holiday.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited (indefinite carryforward under CGI art. 209); utilization is capped per year at EUR 1,000,000 plus 50% of the taxable profit exceeding EUR 1,000,000; optional 3-year carryback capped at EUR 1,000,000.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulaire 2065-SD (Cerfa no. 10963) together with the liasse fiscale 2050-2059-SD; electronically submitted through EDI/EFI on the impots.gouv.fr professional taxpayer portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual tax return; quarterly instalment payments are due on 15 March, 15 June, 15 September and 15 December of the fiscal year.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For fiscal years ending 31 December, due on the second business day following 1 May of the following year. For fiscal years closing on any other date, due within three months of the fiscal year close.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name, SIRET, registered office, legal form, RCS reference, fiscal year opening and closing dates, principal business activity as per APE/ISIC classification.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a French SARL controlled by a foreign parent, enter the head-office identifying details; if a permanent establishment of a non-resident company, file form 2065-B with the non-resident's intra-community VAT and tax residence information.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting profit or loss from the statutory annual accounts, including NVOCC ocean freight brokerage commissions, container slot revenues, and related operational income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile with the audited financial statements of the foreign group; ensure all freight-forwarding invoices issued in EUR, USD, or other currencies are correctly accrued and included.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box C – Détermination du résultat fiscal
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Add back non-deductible expenses such as fines, penalties, non-business entertainment costs, and any excessive depreciation; deduct items benefiting from tax neutrality or explicit loss carryforward.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose all intragroup service charges and cost allocations; any related-party invoicing for logistics services must be supportable by contemporaneous evidence of actual provision and arm's length pricing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Amount of prior-year tax losses (carryforward) deducted from the current year taxable profit; compute the balance for future carryforward under the statutory cap.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Do not combine the French SARL's losses with foreign branche losses; the loss pool is attributable to the French entity only and remains subject to the EUR 1,000,000 + 50% annual cap.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Calculation of corporate income tax at the reduced 15% rate on the first EUR 38,120 of taxable profit and at 25% on the excess; include continuity bands and the social contribution where applicable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm eligibility for the SME reduced rate; a foreign shareholder cannot unilaterally designate the SARL as a large enterprise if the SARL independently satisfies the SME thresholds.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box F – Retenues à la source
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross amounts of French-source income paid to non-residents, including dividends, royalties, interest, and certain fees; applicable withholding tax is calculated and remitted.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach valid Tax Residency Certificates and treaty claim forms; for EU/EEA corporate shareholders claiming the Parent-Subsidiary Directive 0% withholding tax, evidence of 5% shareholding held for two years must be kept on file.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a 10% penalty on net tax due, increased to 20% after formal notice and 40% if not remedied within 30 days; late payment interest accrues at 0.20% per month. Failure to withhold taxes at source carries an additional 50% penalty, and intentional understatement is subject to 40%-80% civil sanctions and potential criminal fines.
